video.caption: Recorded from Sherlock running locally: sign in, open the analysis of Sherlock’s own repository, explore the code graph, then the findings list.

shots.alt: Sherlock landing page: See where a codebase is weak before you read it, with a field to paste a GitHub repository and an example graph
Sherlock analysing its own repository: a score of 56 out of 100, severity counts, and an interactive graph of 1,500 code nodes coloured by findings
The findings list for the same repository: 183 findings with severity and category filters, led by a critical dependency vulnerability

note: Media captured from the app running locally, analysing its own repository. The views shown come from the model-free stage; the AI verification and agent briefing need a local Ollama model and are not shown.
